rule: A control drawn for a login whose cards its own action refuses (backlog #79sqf). scripts/check-control-activity.mjs fails on any finding not listed here and on any entry that is no longer a finding. Each entry is an unfixed fault or a recorded false positive from the check's first run (2026-11-11): FIX it and delete the entry, never treat it as a ruling that it is fine. Never add an entry to make a new control pass: draw the control only when can() asks the activity its action asks. Shrink-only.
